contract.wire: 56-byte caller-sized PointerInputSnapshotV1, capability bit5, optional callback after get_twod_api; required V3 prefix and legacy input unchanged
contract.units: native client pixels right/down; wheel horizontal/vertical 120-unit steps; raw left/right/middle/back/forward bits0..4
contract.bounds: motion +/-65536 pixels and wheel +/-122880 units per axis
contract.ownership: owning non-consuming copies, shared legacy batch sequence; owner admission mutations may neutralize; context alive through Stop/Destroy; serialized game thread
contract.compatibility: C/Zig field-end guards; exact original152 and older2D160 host prefixes, future output suffix preserved; older2D positive probe retained

old_twod_guard.expected_failure: a later optional suffix must not reject a valid legacy 2D host

native.asserts: Actual dynamically loaded C-ABI module changes native Game mesh pixels only under capture; repeated reads same sequence; Fixed/Update dedup; empty batches stable, Escape released, Pause/Step neutral, authored scene unchanged
native.consumer_regression: An initial Fixed-only restored run missed a no-fixed-tick batch (1.59s); consumer now also reads Update with sequence dedup. Three consecutive native passes:5.95/5.82/5.98s before strengthened Pause/Step check.

missing_provider_fault.observation: Withholding pointer capability prevented module start/native Game viewport. Provider restored byte-for-byte; this is a negotiation fault, not a successful pointer operation.

first_full_linux.reason: Old exact capability expectation omitted the newly implemented pointer bit; updated expected complete mask and require nonnull callback. All other tests passed.

validation.interrupted_rerun: After the scene-services expected-mask fix, stopped the early rerun before editing C++ to explicitly initialize Showcase optional pointer suffix null under -Werror. Final Dev now enables Showcase as well as real Zig.

initial_shipping.zig: OFF (real Zig layout/lifecycle tested in Development)
